dominant_strengths: Serif 'Notifications' headline has elegant weight and pairs reasonably with the muted subtitle below it
Color-coded trigger pills (green/blue/amber) communicate notification semantics with clear, restrained signaling
Dark canvas with subtle vignette gives a calm, focused stage for the notification system
dominant_weaknesses: Composition is empty — the entire screen is a vast black void with content stranded mid-page, no stack actually shown
Brief promises a 'notification-stack' but the rendered state shows only triggers; the core artifact (stacked notifications, motion, choreography) is absent
No visible craft in the pills themselves — generic rounded outlines, identical treatment, no hover/active affordance or microtypography hierarchy
fix_priorities: Show an actual notification stack (default state with 2-3 sample toasts) so the design demonstrates its premise
Anchor composition: move triggers to a logical zone and reserve a clear stack region with implied motion/depth
Differentiate the pills with iconography or subtle texture; add hover/press states to suggest behavior
Tighten vertical rhythm — title, subtitle, and triggers float without grid relationship to anything else
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral is muted by the void, behavioral is unproven without a visible stack, and reflective fails because nothing rewards a second look.
rationale.intent_fit: Only partially solves the brief — it sets up notification triggers but never shows the stack itself, which is the entire point.
